scripts.build-frontends: npm run build-frontend:accounts && npm run build-frontend:dashboard && npm run build-frontend:admin-dashboard && npm run build-frontend:status-page && npm run build-frontend:public-dashboard && npm run build-frontend:browser-recorder
scripts.build-frontends:prod: npm run build-frontend:accounts:prod && npm run build-frontend:dashboard:prod && npm run build-frontend:admin-dashboard:prod && npm run build-frontend:status-page:prod && npm run build-frontend:public-dashboard:prod && npm run build-frontend:browser-recorder:prod
scripts.start: heap=8096; for file in "/sys/fs/cgroup$(sed -n 's/^0:://p' /proc/self/cgroup 2>/dev/null)/memory.max" /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes; do limit=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null); case $limit in ''|*[!0-9]*|????????????????*) ;; *) heap=$((limit / 1048576 * 3 / 4)); [ $heap -ge 256 ] || heap=256; [ $heap -le 8096 ] || heap=8096; break ;; esac; done; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=$heap${NODE_OPTIONS:+ $NODE_OPTIONS}" && exec node --no-node-snapshot --require Common/Server/Utils/TsNode/PrecompiledSourceMaps.js Index.js
scripts.migrate: heap=8096; for file in "/sys/fs/cgroup$(sed -n 's/^0:://p' /proc/self/cgroup 2>/dev/null)/memory.max" /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes; do limit=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null); case $limit in ''|*[!0-9]*|????????????????*) ;; *) heap=$((limit / 1048576 * 3 / 4)); [ $heap -ge 256 ] || heap=256; [ $heap -le 8096 ] || heap=8096; break ;; esac; done; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=$heap --max-http-header-size=8388608${NODE_OPTIONS:+ $NODE_OPTIONS}" && exec node --no-node-snapshot --require Common/Server/Utils/TsNode/PrecompiledSourceMaps.js Migrate.js
scripts.clear-modules: rm -rf node_modules && rm package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.test: cd ../.. && export $(grep -v '^#' config.env | xargs) && cd packages/App && rm -rf build && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node node_modules/.bin/jest ./Tests --forceExit --passWithNoTests --maxWorkers=2
